description.value:
The religious symbol of Torag, the forge god—an ornate hammer of dwarven construction—adorns the face of this reinforced steel shield (Hardness 10, HP 24, BT 12). The shield is a religious symbol of Torag.

You and any adjacent allies have fire resistance 5 while you have the shield raised. When used for a Shield Block, the forge warden rings out like the hammer strike of a blacksmith, and the symbol glows as if lit by the fires of a furnace.

Activate (Free Action); Trigger You use the forge warden to Shield Block an adjacent creature's attack and the shield takes damage
The attacking creature takes 2d6 fire damage.
